interpretation: Observed paired heap overhead under the fixed allocation/GC schedule. All 24 matching indices are checked before computing summaries; no absolute-heap threshold is relaxed. Source-derived common allocation is verified against measured increments, not fitted or subtracted as a trend. Present artifacts are hash-verified; missing optional Wasm/full-build artifacts are explicitly recorded, not claimed verified. This is not exact live memory, proof of completed GC, or proof of secure erasure. Samples within each trial are correlated; three deterministic trials show reproducibility, not statistical confidence.
